package protocol

import "strings"

// ProtocolVersion is the wire protocol version this implementation speaks.
// It is a bare major number and MUST be compared for equality — never parsed
// as semver. See protocol/spec — "Two words that mean two things".
const ProtocolVersion = "1"

// SupportedVersions lists every wire protocol version this implementation
// accepts. Reported in OrchestratorInfo.SupportedVersions.
var SupportedVersions = []string{ProtocolVersion}

// IsSupportedVersion reports whether v is a wire protocol version this
// implementation accepts. An empty value means the peer omitted
// protocol_version and defaults to the current wire version.
func IsSupportedVersion(v string) bool {
	if v == "" {
		v = defaultProtocolVersion
	}
	for _, s := range SupportedVersions {
		if s == v {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// Endpoint paths. Every path here is absolute and carries its /v1 prefix: an
// orchestrator or agent URL is an ORIGIN — scheme, host, port — and a client
// composes a request as origin + path.
const (
	// Orchestrator protocol endpoints.
	PathRegister  = "/v1/register"
	PathServices  = "/v1/services"
	PathChannel   = "/v1/channel"
	PathHealth    = "/v1/health"
	PathAudit     = "/v1/audit"
	PathRotateKey = "/v1/rotate-key"

	// Observability. Served without auth.
	PathMetrics = "/metrics"

	// Administrative endpoints backed by state the orchestrator owns.
	PathAdminOperatorsRegister = "/v1/admin/operators/register"
	PathAdminOperatorsToken    = "/v1/admin/operators/token"
	PathAdminOperators         = "/v1/admin/operators"
	PathAdminAgents            = "/v1/admin/agents"
	PathAdminOverview          = "/v1/admin/overview"

	// Agent protocol endpoints the orchestrator calls on registered agents.
	PathAgentEvent    = "/v1/event"
	PathAgentServices = "/v1/services"
)

// PathAdminOperatorByName builds the absolute path for a single operator.
func PathAdminOperatorByName(name string) string {
	return PathAdminOperators + "/" + name
}

// PathAdminOperatorRole builds the absolute path for an operator's role.
func PathAdminOperatorRole(name string) string {
	return PathAdminOperators + "/" + name + "/role"
}

// PathAdminAgentByName builds the absolute path for a single agent.
func PathAdminAgentByName(name string) string {
	return PathAdminAgents + "/" + name
}

// PathAdminAgentDeregister builds the absolute path for force-deregistering
// an agent.
func PathAdminAgentDeregister(name string) string {
	return PathAdminAgents + "/" + name + "/deregister"
}

// Request body ceilings, applied with io.LimitReader on every read.
const (
	// LimitRegistration bounds registration bodies: 1 MB.
	LimitRegistration int64 = 1 << 20
	// LimitMessage bounds agent message bodies: 1 MB.
	LimitMessage int64 = 1 << 20
	// LimitServices bounds service directory update bodies: 1 MB.
	LimitServices int64 = 1 << 20
	// LimitTask bounds task execution bodies: 10 MB.
	LimitTask int64 = 10 << 20
	// LimitChannel bounds channel request bodies: 64 KB.
	LimitChannel int64 = 1 << 16
)

// JoinPath composes a request URL from an origin and an absolute endpoint
// path. The origin carries no path of its own; a trailing slash on it is
// discarded so that origin + path is exact.
func JoinPath(origin, path string) string {
	return strings.TrimRight(origin, "/") + path
}
